correctness.rationale: The determinant of the even length-six loop exponent matrix B is prod b_i -1. The witness b=(4,6,5,6,6,4) has d=17279 and weights (3723,2387,2957,2494,2315,3389) solving b_i a_i+a_{i+1}=d; sum=17265 gives K=14H. Pairwise coprimality ensures ambient wellformedness; affine partial derivative zero locus is the origin because nonzero coordinates would force prod b_i=1. Esser’s determinant rationality theorem applies, and first Reid–Tai age 2301/2315<1 shows noncanonical singularity. Independently recomputed via distinct full enumeration of all 537221 rotation-normalized exponent orderings with prod b_i<=17280; exactly eight qualifying numerical tuples and all have d=17279. This is exhaustive of a superset satisfying only ambient wellformedness and K-positivity, so rules out lower degree in the target family.
